description: This file defines a dialog configuration for the 'button' element in CKEditor, specifying UI setup, content, and behavior for editing button properties within the editor.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog with existing button element attributes when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Creates or inserts the button element into the editor when the dialog is confirmed.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Initializes content fields in the dialog with existing element attributes.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Applies dialog content changes back to the element attributes.
